# 5秒 FL2VA 提示词｜魔法少女起身前行变身定格

How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 4) aligns with the 5.00-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1 | 0.00s–1.00s] A low-angle cinematic shot begins on the magical girl in Picture 1, seated on the classical marble column beneath the glowing moon halo in a starry night sky. She is a blonde magical girl with twin odango buns, long twin tails, blue eyes, and a moon-themed sailor-inspired outfit in white, navy blue, crimson red, and gold. She gently lifts her chin, gives a calm confident smile, and shifts her weight forward. Her long hair and skirt edges sway softly in the night breeze. She pushes off the column with her right hand, rises gracefully from the seated pose to standing, and steps down in one elegant continuous motion. The camera pulls back slightly and tilts upward to keep her centered while preserving her identity, hairstyle, face, outfit colors, and moon-halo atmosphere.

[Shot 2 | 1.00s–2.20s] After standing up, she immediately begins walking forward with calm elegance. As she takes her first graceful steps, moonlight ignites around her feet and climbs upward in swirling ribbons of light. A luminous circular magic aura spreads beneath her, while sparkling particles, floating feathers, crescent-shaped light trails, and star glints spiral around her body. The transformation begins quickly but smoothly: her bodice becomes more ornate and fitted, gold trims brighten, and small celestial ornaments appear along her collar, waist, and gloves. The camera tracks backward smoothly, keeping her full body readable and preserving face and hair consistency.

[Shot 3 | 2.20s–3.80s] The transformation intensifies into a luxurious full-body metamorphosis. A crescent-moon staff forms in her hand from converging beams of gold and blue light, assembling rapidly from glowing particles, wing-like motifs, and a heart-shaped jewel core. At the same time, large luminous white wings bloom from behind her shoulders and unfold in layered motion with soft feather movement and radiant rim light. Her skirt gains layered translucent flowing fabric, her jewelry becomes richer and more celestial, and her boots, waist ornaments, and chest bow settle into a regal winged moon-warrior design inspired by Picture 2. The night sky deepens into a grand celestial backdrop with a brighter crescent moon, richer nebula clouds, and denser star sparkle. She continues walking forward in a poised elegant rhythm while the camera widens for a heroic reveal.

[Shot 4 | 3.80s–5.00s] She completes the transformation and fully reaches the final form shown in Picture 2: standing front-facing in a majestic full-body pose on a glowing magic circle high above a city at night, holding the crescent staff in her right hand, with large angelic white wings fully spread. Her long blonde twin tails flow outward, the moon halo and crescent moon align behind her, and the outfit is now a refined celestial battle-dress with white, deep blue, red, and gold detailing. She takes one last small step forward, slows to a stop, plants her feet with confidence, raises the staff slightly, and holds a final elegant heroic pose. The last frame is stable, radiant, clear, and visually aligned with Picture 2.

overall_soundscape: Soft night wind, subtle fabric rustle, gentle heel steps, rising magical shimmer, sparkling chimes, feather flutter, airy whooshes during the transformation, luminous energy surges as the wings and staff form, and a soft radiant hum from the magic circle. No dialogue.

non_diegetic_music: A luxurious and uplifting magical-girl transformation score with delicate piano and bell textures at the start, quickly building into shimmering strings, celestial choir pads, and a triumphant orchestral swell as the wings and staff appear, then resolving into a bright heroic finish at the final pose.
